title: Rice MMKG — Rice Multimodal Knowledge Graph
description: Rice MMKG is a knowledge graph for rice disease and pest diagnosis, populated from the Paddy Doctor image dataset. It links diseases, pests, pathogens, symptoms, environmental factors, growth stages, and management knowledge, and separates raw dataset annotation (annotatedAs) from domain-knowledge evidence (captures/indicates). Every domain-level assertion (266 as of v0.5) is grounded in peer-reviewed agronomic literature and authoritative databases (IRRI Rice Doctor Knowledge Bank, CABI Crop Protection Compendium, EPPO Global Database, and BBPOPT), formally traceable via OWL axiom annotations.
